description: Allows the addition, modification and deletion of tokens in a Consul cluster using the agent. For more details on using and configuring ACLs, see https://www.consul.io/docs/guides/acl.html.

parameters.name: accessor_id
parameters.description: Specifies a UUID to use as the token’s Accessor ID. If not specified a UUID is generated for this field.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Free form human readable description of the token.

parameters.name: expiration_ttl
parameters.description: This is a convenience field and if set it initializes the expiration_time. Can be specified in the form of 60s or 5m (that is, 60 seconds or 5 minutes, respectively). Ingored when the token is updated!

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: If true, indicates that the token should not be replicated globally and instead be local to the current datacenter. Choices: false true

parameters.name: node_identities
parameters.description: List of node identities to attach to the token. If not specified, any node identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array ([]), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: The nodes datacenter. This results in effective token only being valid in this datacenter.

parameters.name: node_name
parameters.description: The name of the node. Must not be longer than 256 characters, must start and end with a lowercase alphanumeric character. May only contain lowercase alphanumeric characters as well as - and _.

parameters.name: policies
parameters.description: List of policies to attach to the token. Each policy is a dict. If the parameter is left blank, any policies currently assigned are not changed. Any empty array ([]) clears any policies previously set.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the policy to attach to this token; see community.general.consul_policy for more info. Either this or policies[].name must be specified.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the policy to attach to this token; see community.general.consul_policy for more info. Either this or policies[].id must be specified.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: List of roles to attach to the token. Each role is a dict. If the parameter is left blank, any roles currently assigned are not changed. Any empty array ([]) clears any roles previously set.

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: secret_id
parameters.description: Specifies a UUID to use as the token’s Secret ID. If not specified a UUID is generated for this field.

parameters.name: service_identities
parameters.description: List of service identities to attach to the token. If not specified, any service identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array ([]), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

parameters.name: datacenters
parameters.description: The datacenters where the token is effective. If an empty array ([]) is specified, the token is valid in all datacenters. Including those which do not yet exist but may in the future.

parameters.name: service_name
parameters.description: The name of the service. Must not be longer than 256 characters, must start and end with a lowercase alphanumeric character. May only contain lowercase alphanumeric characters as well as - and _.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the token should be present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: templated_policies
parameters.description: The list of templated policies that should be applied to the role.

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.description: The templated policy name.

parameters.name: template_variables
parameters.description: The templated policy variables. Not all templated policies require variables.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token to use for authorization.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create / Update a token by accessor_id
  community.general.consul_token:
    state: present
    accessor_id: 07a7de84-c9c7-448a-99cc-beaf682efd21
    token: 8adddd91-0bd6-d41d-ae1a-3b49cfa9a0e8
    roles:
      - name: role1
      - name: role2
    service_identities:
      - service_name: service1
        datacenters: [dc1, dc2]
    node_identities:
      - node_name: node1
        datacenter: dc1
    expiration_ttl: 50m

- name: Delete a token
  community.general.consul_token:
    state: absent
    accessor_id: 07a7de84-c9c7-448a-99cc-beaf682efd21
    token: 8adddd91-0bd6-d41d-ae1a-3b49cfa9a0e8

return_values.name: operation
return_values.description: The operation performed. Returned: changed Sample: "update"

return_values.name: token
return_values.description: The token as returned by the Consul HTTP API. Returned: always Sample: {"AccessorID": "07a7de84-c9c7-448a-99cc-beaf682efd21", "CreateIndex": 632, "CreateTime": "2024-01-14T21:53:01.402749174+01:00", "Description": "Testing", "Hash": "rj5PeDHddHslkpW7Ij4OD6N4bbSXiecXFmiw2SYXg2A=", "Local": false, "ModifyIndex": 633, "SecretID": "bd380fba-da17-7cee-8576-8d6427c6c930", "ServiceIdentities": [{"ServiceName": "test"}]}
